### Giving Caesar His Due
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/giving-caesar-his-due
Passage: Matthew 22:15-22
Points:
- Religious and political rivals joined forces in an effort to trap Jesus with a divisive question on Roman taxation.
- Jesus revealed their hypocrisy when they produced a Roman denarius stamped with the emperor’s portrait and claims of divinity.
- Since the coin carried Caesar's likeness, returning it to the civil authority did not compromise true worship of God.
- Christians have a duty to obey government regulations and pay taxes as long as the state does not demand what belongs to God alone.

### Render to Caesar the Things That Are Caesar’s
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/render-to-caesar-the-things-that-are-caesars
Passage: Matthew 22:21
Points:
- Jesus instructed His followers to give rightful honor and payment even to an unbelieving, pagan ruler.
- Because all creation belongs to God, civil rulers hold only limited and derived authority permitted by Him.
- Christians submit to human governments not because the state is supreme, but out of obedience to God.
- Believers live as heavenly citizens whose primary allegiance belongs solely to their Creator and Redeemer.
